Delivering 3200W continuous power with 80 PLUS® 230V EU Internal Platinum efficiency, the AX 3200W is engineered for AI workstations and multi-GPU systems. Fully compatible with the ATX 3.1 specification, it features four native PCIe Gen 5.1 12V-2×6 connectors, a robust single +12V rail, premium Japanese capacitors, and fully modular low-profile cables to provide exceptional stability, efficiency, and reliability for demanding workloads.

Built for AI Workstations Built for the next generation of AI computing, the AX 3200W delivers 3200W continuous power with exceptional stability and efficiency for professional workstation environments. Featuring four native PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2×6) connectors, ATX 3.1 compatibility, and a high amperage single +12V rail, it is designed to power multiple high-performance GPUs and meet the demands of AI training, rendering, simulation, and other GPU-intensive workloads. Fully Compatible With ATX 3.1 Specifications  The AX 3200W fully complies with the latest ATX 3.1 specification, supporting up to 200% power excursion, improved low-load efficiency, and updated power timing requirements. Designed with four native PCIe 12V-2×6 modular interfaces, it provides stable and reliable power for multiple high-performance graphics cards and demanding AI applications. PCIe Gen 5.1 Ready Featuring four native PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2×6) connectors, the AX 3200W is ready for next-generation graphics cards and multi-GPU AI workstations. The dual-color connector design helps ensure secure installation while reducing the risk of improper cable insertion for safer system operation. Note:Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power requirements vary depending on hardware configuration and workload. Please follow the graphics card manufacturer's recommended power requirements before using the 12V-2×6 cable. Ultra Quiet 140 mm Dual Ball Bearing Fan  Equipped with a 140 mm dual ball bearing fan, the AX 3200W provides excellent cooling performance and long-term durability. The optimized cooling design maintains stable operation under sustained heavy workloads while minimizing noise for professional computing environments.  High Amperage Single +12V Rail and Advanced Circuit Design  A powerful single +12V rail delivers outstanding compatibility and stable high-current output for demanding computing platforms. Combined with advanced DC-to-DC and LLC circuit design, the AX 3200W provides precise voltage regulation, improved power stability, and exceptional efficiency for AI and workstation applications. textSegments: Delivering 3200W continuous power with 80 PLUS® 230V EU Internal Platinum efficiency, the AX 3200W is engineered for AI workstations and multi-GPU systems. Fully compatible with the ATX 3.1 specification, it features four native PCIe Gen 5.1 12V-2×6 connectors, a robust single +12V rail, premium Japanese capacitors, and fully modular low-profile cables to provide exceptional stability, efficiency, and reliability for demanding workloads.

Built for the next generation of AI computing, the AX 3200W delivers 3200W continuous power with exceptional stability and efficiency for professional workstation environments. Featuring four native PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2×6) connectors, ATX 3.1 compatibility, and a high amperage single +12V rail, it is designed to power multiple high-performance GPUs and meet the demands of AI training, rendering, simulation, and other GPU-intensive workloads.

The AX 3200W fully complies with the latest ATX 3.1 specification, supporting up to 200% power excursion, improved low-load efficiency, and updated power timing requirements. Designed with four native PCIe 12V-2×6 modular interfaces, it provides stable and reliable power for multiple high-performance graphics cards and demanding AI applications.

Featuring four native PCIe Gen 5.1 (12V-2×6) connectors, the AX 3200W is ready for next-generation graphics cards and multi-GPU AI workstations. The dual-color connector design helps ensure secure installation while reducing the risk of improper cable insertion for safer system operation.
Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power requirements vary depending on hardware configuration and workload.
Please follow the graphics card manufacturer's recommended power requirements before using the 12V-2×6 cable.
Ultra Quiet 140 mm Dual Ball Bearing Fan

Equipped with a 140 mm dual ball bearing fan, the AX 3200W provides excellent cooling performance and long-term durability. The optimized cooling design maintains stable operation under sustained heavy workloads while minimizing noise for professional computing environments.
High Amperage Single +12V Rail and Advanced Circuit Design

A powerful single +12V rail delivers outstanding compatibility and stable high-current output for demanding computing platforms. Combined with advanced DC-to-DC and LLC circuit design, the AX 3200W provides precise voltage regulation, improved power stability, and exceptional efficiency for AI and workstation applications.
Fully Modular with Flat Black Cables

The AX 3200W features a fully modular Zero Cable Platform with premium low-profile etched black cables, making cable routing easier while reducing cable clutter inside the chassis. The clean layout improves airflow and creates a more organized system for professional builds.

Built-in protections including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection (OTP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) safeguard your system against electrical faults, providing peace of mind and reliable operation.

The AX Series delivers up to 94% efficiency and is certified to 80 PLUS® 230V EU Internal Platinum, reducing energy consumption, heat generation, and operating costs while maintaining outstanding power delivery under demanding workloads.

The AX Series supports Intel C6/C7 states, Intel Deep Power Down, and Energy Star 5.0 for improved energy efficiency. It also complies with EU WEEE and RoHS directives, reflecting Thermaltake's commitment to environmentally responsible product design and manufacturing.

Built with 100% high-quality Japanese 105°C electrolytic capacitors, the AX 3200W delivers superior durability, long-term reliability, and exceptional electrical stability, ensuring consistent performance even under continuous heavy loads.
